name: Suzuki GS450
engine: 448 cc air-cooled DOHC parallel twin, two carbs
intro: A light, simple twin. Clean carbs, set valves and air leaks decide how it runs.

G: Clean carbs, set valves, no intake leaks, a clean tank and a working petcock all have to be right for it to run well.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
